name: challenge
title: The booking office
summary: Workers book seats from a shared count until the office refuses, confirming each booking first. The office as written sells seats it does not have; three other versions try to fix it, and two succeed.

controls.name: steps
controls.label: Busy steps to confirm a booking

controls.name: version
controls.label: The office
controls.hint: as written: a plain check and a plain decrement. with atomics: an atomic check and an atomic decrement. compare-and-swap: take the seat only if the count is unchanged. under a lock: check and take with nobody else inside.

results.name: oversold
results.label: Oversold
results.what: booked minus the seats on sale

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing

trace.what: a model of two workers and the last seat
